The changed ranges per file_changes are head 1087-1090, 1101-1148 and 2030-2047, which are outside the supplied excerpts. This is documentation only; I did not verify that the code matches it.

Remaining questions for integration: (1) the changed ranges beyond line 797 (1087-1148, 2030-2047) were not supplied, so those hunks were not reviewed; (2) the scheduler-geometry doc changes (wider Gemma 4 prefill chunk, media chunk ceiling) imply code changes elsewhere in EngineV2Factory+Configuration.swift that may affect availability/memory admission (T-010, T-029). These should be reviewed with the source diffs if they are in the PR. No threat-model updates are needed based on the supplied text.
